scientific_question: Can two strict accepted 16-node real-HeadCalc origins be constructed with the same total profile water and the same upper-30-cm water, but materially different deeper vertical distribution, without using any interface-response quantity for construction or selection?
rationale: E02 supports vertical-distribution memory at equal total profile water, but its selected pair differs in upper-30-cm water.
The next state-sufficiency rung must therefore control both total storage and an explicit root-zone storage surrogate before any fixed-Hc response probe.

A zero-divergence two-stage throughflow reversal is used because every interval has identical top and bottom boundary flux, so total profile water is constrained while fast upper-profile recovery can precede deeper redistribution recovery.

forcing_design.integrated_boundary_divergence: zero in every interval because q_top == q_bottom

execution_contract: each family starts from the same freshly constructed B01 Se=0.85 physical origin
every interval uses Reference-floor sample semantics with one physical advance and no automatic temporal subdivision
only strict samples with complete mass accounting and |residual|<=1e-12 cm may commit
a failed sample terminates that family and must leave the latest committed origin bit-identical
emit only family/phase/step/time plus committed pressure-head and water-content vectors for selection
do not emit or parse bottom exchange, terminal flux, tangent or future-response quantities

eligible_pairs: BASE_EQ versus any RECOVER state from DRY_RECOVER or WET_RECOVER
RECOVER state from DRY_RECOVER versus RECOVER state from WET_RECOVER
response_blind_selection.no_match: Close E03 NO_MATCH without changing amplitudes, dt, stage lengths, tolerances or state thresholds.

qualification_gates: accepted candidate prefixes consist only of strict mass-complete commits
failed interval, if any, leaves latest committed origin unchanged
selected pair, if any, is persisted with all 16 H/theta values before any response experiment
next_if_selected: GC-RZM06E04 must preregister exact common-time reconstruction of the immutable E03 pair and only then run an identical forcing-free fixed-Hc response probe with both W_profile and W_root30 gates enforced.
controls: no HELD_OUT or FALLBACK state access
no direct mutation of live committed state
no production source or coupling API change
nonclaims: E03 selection alone does not prove an additional state variable is required
upper-30-cm water is a bounded root-zone storage surrogate for this carrier, not a universal SWAP root-state definition
no production coupling admission follows from E03
